title: Willowbrook and a guided campaign companion

features.title: One code for the complete collection
features.description: Activate Willowbrook’s 85 designs with one purchase code. The separate STL download works with other slicers; the scenery licence permits sales of physical prints.

features.title: Your world informs your campaign
features.description: Optional AI guidance receives linked-world encounter names, elevations and piece positions, with clear limits when layouts are too large. Your worlds stay on this PC unless you approve sending context to your provider.

features.title: Simple suggested answers
features.description: The campaign companion guides new players one question at a time. Suggested answers fill an editable message; you decide when to send it and which proposed changes to apply.
